title: Proxmox & Ceph logs
description: Syslog of the PVE nodes (pvestatd, pveproxy, pvedaemon, HA, corosync, qmeventd, tasks, kernel) and the Ceph cluster log (health changes, OSD events, slow ops).

list.name: cephmon
list.label: Ceph mon
list.description: Every mon sends the same cluster log: read one copy.

list.name: search
list.label: Search (regex)
list.description: Case-insensitive RE2 regex on the line; empty matches everything.

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: Lines at error or worse from the selected nodes.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source=~"journal|syslog", host=~"$node"} |~ `(?i)$search` | regexp `(?:\blevel="?|\blvl=|^\[|\] |^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\S+Z\s+)(?P<lvl_>[A-Za-z]+)` | label_format level=`{{ $l := lower (or (and .container .lvl_) .level) }}{{ if eq $l "error" "err" "eror" "e" "crit" "critical" "alert" "emerg" "emergency" "fatal" "panic" }}error{{ else if eq $l "warning" "warn" "w" }}warning{{ else if eq $l "notice" }}notice{{ else if eq $l "debug" "trace" "d" }}debug{{ else }}info{{ end }}` | drop lvl_ | level="error" [$__range])) or vector(0)

sum(count_over_time({source=~"journal|syslog", host=~"$node"} |~ `(?i)$search` | regexp `(?:\blevel="?|\blvl=|^\[|\] |^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\S+Z\s+)(?P<lvl_>[A-Za-z]+)` | label_format level=`{{ $l := lower (or (and .container .lvl_) .level) }}{{ if eq $l "error" "err" "eror" "e" "crit" "critical" "alert" "emerg" "emergency" "fatal" "panic" }}error{{ else if eq $l "warning" "warn" "w" }}warning{{ else if eq $l "notice" }}notice{{ else if eq $l "debug" "trace" "d" }}debug{{ else }}info{{ end }}` | drop lvl_ | level="warning" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Failed tasks
panels.description: PVE tasks that ended with something other than OK.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source=~"journal|syslog", host=~"$node"} |~ `(?i)$search` |= "end task UPID" !~ `: OK\s*$` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Corosync events
panels.description: corosync/pmxcfs: link up/down, membership and quorum changes, token loss.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source=~"journal|syslog", host=~"$node", app=~"corosync|pmxcfs"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `(?i:host: \d+ link: \d+ is (up|down)|new membership|members\[|quorum|token has not been received|retransmit list|failed to receive)` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: HA events
panels.description: pve-ha-crm/lrm lines (service starts, migrations, fencing).

panels.title: Auth failures
panels.description: PVE web/API (pveproxy, pvedaemon) and SSH login failures.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source=~"journal|syslog", host=~"$node"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `(?i)authentication failure|auth fail|failed password|invalid user` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Lines by app (top 10 per bucket)
panels.description: The 10 busiest apps of each bucket, so more than 10 over the range; the legend is sorted by total.

panels.title: Errors and warnings by node
panels.description: Syslog severity err or worse, and warning.

targets.expr: sum by (host, level) (count_over_time({source=~"journal|syslog", host=~"$node"} |~ `(?i)$search` | regexp `(?:\blevel="?|\blvl=|^\[|\] |^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\S+Z\s+)(?P<lvl_>[A-Za-z]+)` | label_format level=`{{ $l := lower (or (and .container .lvl_) .level) }}{{ if eq $l "error" "err" "eror" "e" "crit" "critical" "alert" "emerg" "emergency" "fatal" "panic" }}error{{ else if eq $l "warning" "warn" "w" }}warning{{ else if eq $l "notice" }}notice{{ else if eq $l "debug" "trace" "d" }}debug{{ else }}info{{ end }}` | drop lvl_ | level=~`error|warning` [$__auto]))

panels.title: Corosync events by node
panels.description: corosync/pmxcfs: link up/down, membership and quorum changes, token loss.

targets.expr: sum by (host) (count_over_time({source=~"journal|syslog", host=~"$node", app=~"corosync|pmxcfs"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `(?i:host: \d+ link: \d+ is (up|down)|new membership|members\[|quorum|token has not been received|retransmit list|failed to receive)` [$__auto]))

panels.title: corosync / pmxcfs
panels.description: Cluster communication and the cluster filesystem (/etc/pve).

panels.title: HA manager
panels.description: pve-ha-crm (cluster resource manager) and pve-ha-lrm (local resource manager).

panels.title: Tasks by type (range)
panels.description: PVE tasks started in the time range (qmstart, vzdump, vncproxy, ...).

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(15, sum by (task) (count_over_time({source=~"journal|syslog", host=~"$node"} |~ `(?i)$search` |= " task UPID:" | regexp `<(?P<user>[^>]+)> (?P<what>starting|end) task UPID:(?P<tnode>[^:]+):[^:]+:[^:]+:[^:]+:(?P<task>[^:]+):(?P<vmid>[^:]*):[^:]+:\s*(?P<status>[^\n]*)` | what=`starting` [$__range]))))

panels.title: Tasks
panels.description: Task starts and ends (pvedaemon, pveproxy, pvescheduler, ...).

panels.title: Guest lifecycle
panels.description: qmeventd (VM start/stop/cleanup), qm/pct and scheduled jobs.

panels.title: pvestatd / pveproxy / pvedaemon
panels.description: PVE daemons, without pvestatd's 'status update time' lines.

panels.title: Kernel errors and warnings
panels.description: Kernel lines at warning or worse.

panels.title: Health checks raised
panels.description: 'Health check failed' and 'Health check update' lines from the cluster log (one mon's copy, the Ceph mon picker), as in the panels below.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({app="ceph-cluster", host="${cephmon}"} |~ `(?i)$search` |= "Health check cleared" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: OSD events
panels.description: OSDs marked down/out/in, failed, booting.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({app="ceph-cluster", host="${cephmon}"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `(?i:osd\.\d+ (\[[^\]]*\] )?boot|osd\.\d+ (marked|failed|reported)|marked osd\.\d+|marking osd\.\d+|osd\.\d+ out\b)` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Slow ops lines
panels.description: Slow ops/requests and BlueStore slow operation warnings (BLUESTORE_SLOW_OP_ALERT is pre-existing on osd.0).

panels.title: Cluster log lines
panels.description: Without [DBG] (pgmap) lines.

panels.title: Cluster log by severity
panels.description: [INF], [WRN], [ERR] lines of the cluster log; [DBG] (pgmap every few seconds) is left out.

panels.title: Health checks raised
panels.description: Health checks raised or updated per bucket, by check code.

defaults.noValue: No health checks raised in range

panels.title: Health checks raised (range)
panels.description: How often each health check was raised.

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (check) (count_over_time({app="ceph-cluster", host="${cephmon}"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `Health check (failed|update)` | regexp `\((?P<check>[A-Z0-9_]+)\)\s*$` [$__range]))))

panels.title: Health changes
panels.description: Health checks raised, updated and cleared.

panels.title: OSD events and slow ops
panels.description: OSD state changes and slow ops, without the periodic 'overall HEALTH_...' summary.

panels.title: Cluster log (without DBG)
panels.description: The cluster log minus [DBG] (pgmap) lines.

panels.title: Ceph daemons and kernel client
panels.description: Ceph daemons' journal lines and the kernel's libceph/rbd messages on the selected nodes.
